response.overview: It tells the story of Hassan (Hairul Azreen) who left his family as a child and then joined the military because he could not bear to see his family and those around him controlled by Raja (Dain Said). After completing his service to the country, Hassan returns to his family to settle his younger brother Zain's (Fify Azmi) debt from a loss in an MMA competition organized by Raja. Hassan and Zain must compete once more against Raja's children, Vee (Ismi Melinda) and Rayyan (Josiah Hogan).
